subject: Request: Interim endorsement for SOC 2 post-report period (audit gap clarification) - VelaHealth
transcript:
From: Alyssa Trent <alyssa.trent@velahealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@velahealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Feb 2024 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: interim endorsement for audit period (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement sprint we need an interim endorsement covering the period after Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2023-12-31) up to the current date. Our procurement team calls this an "endorsement/bridge" note — it just needs to confirm no material changes to controls and list any exceptions or planned remediations.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide this kind of short letter (1 page) and whether you have a templated attestation we can use for our security review? Also, we have a short artifacts checklist attached (VelaHealth_SOC2_req_list.xlsx) — can you confirm which items you can provide within 7 business days?

Appreciate your help,

Alyssa Trent
Sr. Security Program Manager
VelaHealth

---
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Trent <alyssa.trent@velahealth.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Feb 2024 13:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: interim endorsement for audit period (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note and the checklist. We can provide an interim endorsement (we typically call it a post-period affirmation) that: 1) confirms the SOC 2 Type II report ended 2023-12-31, 2) states whether there have been any material changes to the control environment since that date, and 3) lists any known exceptions or mitigation timelines.

A couple of clarifying questions so we scope the letter correctly:
- Do you need the statement to be signed by our security/compliance lead or is a Redmond-based director-level signatory acceptable?
- For artifacts, are you looking for system-level evidence (e.g., KMS configuration screenshots, recent penetration test summary) or administrative artifacts (policies, SOC 2 management assertion)?

We can turn around a short letter in ~3 business days once we know the signatory and which artifacts to include. Attaching our SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2_TypeII_20231231.pdf) and a draft one-page endorsement for your review.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_20231231.pdf, Draft_Bridge_Letter_VelaHealth_20240314.docx

---
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Feb 2024 09:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: interim endorsement for audit period (VelaHealth) — please advise artifacts and approval

Team — forwarding VelaHealth's checklist and Alyssa's ask. Key asks: 1) one-page endorsement covering 2024-01-01 through current date (no material changes if true), 2) confirmation of signatory (we prefer Compliance Director sign-off), 3) artifacts within 7 business days.

Can Soojin please check the artifacts list and confirm what we can provide immediately (screenshots, policies, high-level config exports). Marissa — once Soojin confirms, can you help finalize the one-page wording and route to legal for a quick sign-off? We should avoid operational specifics in the letter — stick to control assertions and note that evidence is available on request.

Thanks — we need to be back to Alyssa by 2024-03-06 to meet their procurement timeline.

Jonas

---
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 7 Mar 2024 11:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: interim endorsement for audit period (VelaHealth) — artifacts inventory

Jonas / Marissa — I reviewed the attached checklist. Items we can provide within 3 business days:
- Management assertion (signed)
- SOC 2 Type II report (attached)
- Recent change-control summary (last 90 days)
- KMS configuration export (redacted for tenant IDs)
- Pen test executive summary (redacted)

Items that will take longer (10–14 business days):
- Full configuration exports for production clusters (needs infra team coordination)
- Detailed access review logs beyond 30 days (requires data-retention run)

I drafted a short endorsement template and attached it as Draft_Bridge_Letter_VelaHealth_20240314.docx. It uses language we typically use for post-period affirmations and avoids operational detail. No material changes to controls to report as of 2024-03-07.

If Legal is OK with the signatory being Director of Compliance (myself), I can sign and we can send by EOD 2024-03-14.

Soojin
Compliance Director, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Draft_Bridge_Letter_VelaHealth_20240314.docx

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Trent <alyssa.trent@velahealth.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2024 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: interim endorsement for audit period (SOC 2 Type II)

Hi Alyssa — thank you for the checklist and patience. Attached is our interim endorsement (one page) and the SOC 2 Type II report. Summary:
- Report period: 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31
- Effective as of: 2024-03-14 (no material changes to control environment since report end date)
- Signatory: Soojin Lee, Director of Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Draft_Bridge_Letter_VelaHealth_20240314.docx (signed), SOC2_TypeII_20231231.pdf

If you need additional artifacts from the checklist, please indicate priority and we'll provide the items with the timelines Soojin listed. Happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through the artifacts if that helps accelerate procurement.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

---
On Thu, 14 Mar 2024 at 09:20 Alyssa Trent <alyssa.trent@velahealth.com> wrote:
Thanks Marissa — this is perfect. We'll attach the endorsement to our security review and follow up if we need additional evidence. One quick ask: could you also add a one-line note confirming whether Redwood has rotated all customer-facing KMS keys since 2023-12-31 or, if not rotated, that key rotation is on the normal schedule (no unusual events)? If you can add that line, that would close our checklist.

[End of thread]
